artifact_schema.description: A batch of 1 to 16 distinguished orbits: {"dps": [{x, seed, j}, ...]}.

dps.description: 1 to 16 orbits; each element carries x, seed and j.

statement: Contribute distinguished orbits to the shared rho search for the 21-bit Koblitz instance in examples/certicom-ecdlp/jobs/ecc2k-23.json (job id c22d2033b98a00dbf6635349d70278294c654a6f717c54389c217cde448099f6). This is ECC2K-130's protocol at a scale that finishes in a second: the same curve shape y^2 + xy = x^3 + 1 over GF(2^m), the same iteration R -> R + sigma^j(R), the same <-1> x <sigma> orbits, the same eight-counter witness, and the same rule that an orbit is a unit and is paid once. It exists so the mechanism is exercised end to end rather than described. Submit up to 16 orbits per claim as {"dps": [{"x", "seed", "j"}, ...]}. Whoever reaches an orbit already in the log holds a collision and claims objective-ecc2k-23.json with k.
